text: Aziz opens the mobile bank at breakfast to check his balance.
prefix: Aziz opens the mobile bank at breakfast to check his balance.

text: He opens it again at lunch, and once more at night.
prefix: He opens it again at lunch, and once more at night.

text: He never types his password.
prefix: He never types his password.

text: So what lets him in, again and again, without a login?
prefix: So what lets him in, again and again, without a login?

text: In Lesson 20, his phone got a record and a state, and the gateway checked the binding at each request.
prefix: In Lesson 20, his phone got a record and a state, and the gateway checked the binding at each request.

text: This lesson shows what the app holds when it calls: the access grant, its tokens, its level and its renewal.
prefix: This lesson shows what the app holds when it calls: the access grant, its tokens, its level and its renewal.

text: An access grant is a session.
prefix: An access grant is a session.

text: It belongs to one app account, on one device, for one customer.
prefix: It belongs to one app account, on one device, for one customer.

text: Aziz got his first grant on registration day, at level one.
prefix: Aziz got his first grant on registration day, at level one.

text: He gets a new one after each login.
prefix: He gets a new one after each login.

text: Two parts of the platform take part, and they have very different jobs.
prefix: Two parts of the platform take part, and they have very different jobs.

text: The customer gateway decides.
prefix: The customer gateway decides.

text: It checks the password, the code, the verdict and the device binding.
prefix: It checks the password, the code, the verdict and the device binding.

text: Keycloak only issues.
prefix: Keycloak only issues.

text: When the gateway is satisfied, it signs a short note for Keycloak.
prefix: When the gateway is satisfied, it signs a short note for Keycloak.

text: The note says three things: this device, this customer, this session level.
prefix: The note says three things: this device, this customer, this session level.

text: It is valid for a very short time, and only once.
prefix: It is valid for a very short time, and only once.

text: Keycloak reads the note and issues two tokens: an access token and a refresh token.
prefix: Keycloak reads the note and issues two tokens: an access token and a refresh token.

text: I think this is the right split.
prefix: I think this is the right split.

text: Keycloak is a well-known engine for tokens, but it knows nothing about TAF, MyID or the bank's rules.
prefix: Keycloak is a well-known engine for tokens, but it knows nothing about TAF, MyID or the bank's rules.

text: All those rules stay in the gateway, so a new version of Keycloak never changes how the bank decides.
prefix: All those rules stay in the gateway, so a new version of Keycloak never changes how the bank decides.

text: Now look at what the access token says.
prefix: Now look at what the access token says.

text: First, it names its own app.
prefix: First, it names its own app.

text: A mobile bank token never opens the marketplace, as Lesson 5 showed.
prefix: A mobile bank token never opens the marketplace, as Lesson 5 showed.

text: Second, it carries the session level: one or two.
prefix: Second, it carries the session level: one or two.

text: The gateway writes level two only when the customer is at level two and the device is Trusted.
prefix: The gateway writes level two only when the customer is at level two and the device is Trusted.

text: On registration day, Aziz's token said level one.
prefix: On registration day, Aziz's token said level one.

text: A week later he passed MyID on this phone, and the gateway issued a new token with level two at once.
prefix: A week later he passed MyID on this phone, and the gateway issued a new token with level two at once.

text: He did not wait for the old token to run out.
prefix: He did not wait for the old token to run out.

text: So any app, and any backend of the bank, can read the level straight from the token.
prefix: So any app, and any backend of the bank, can read the level straight from the token.

text: Back to breakfast.
prefix: Back to breakfast.

text: The access token lives only a short time, on purpose.
prefix: The access token lives only a short time, on purpose.

text: When it runs out, the app does not ask Aziz for anything.
prefix: When it runs out, the app does not ask Aziz for anything.

text: It sends the refresh token to the gateway, with its device identifier.
prefix: It sends the refresh token to the gateway, with its device identifier.

text: This is a renewal.
prefix: This is a renewal.

text: The gateway renews only for the same device and the same app.
prefix: The gateway renews only for the same device and the same app.

text: Before anything else, the renewal passes the binding check from Lesson 20.
prefix: Before anything else, the renewal passes the binding check from Lesson 20.

text: Then the gateway looks at the revocation list.
prefix: Then the gateway looks at the revocation list.

text: This list holds every grant that was ended, and the gateway reads it at each call.
prefix: This list holds every grant that was ended, and the gateway reads it at each call.

text: If both checks pass, Keycloak gives a fresh access token, and a fresh refresh token too.
prefix: If both checks pass, Keycloak gives a fresh access token, and a fresh refresh token too.

text: The old refresh token is now used up.
prefix: The old refresh token is now used up.

text: If someone tries to use it a second time, Keycloak sees the reuse.
prefix: If someone tries to use it a second time, Keycloak sees the reuse.

text: A renewal needs no password.
prefix: A renewal needs no password.

text: The password opens a login, and a renewal is not a login.
prefix: The password opens a login, and a renewal is not a login.

text: It only continues one.
prefix: It only continues one.

text: There is one more limit.
prefix: There is one more limit.

text: When Aziz leaves the app alone for longer than the inactivity limit, the app asks for his app PIN.
prefix: When Aziz leaves the app alone for longer than the inactivity limit, the app asks for his app PIN.

text: The grant does not end.
prefix: The grant does not end.

text: The PIN only unlocks the app on this phone again.
prefix: The PIN only unlocks the app on this phone again.

text: The bank sets the full lifetime of a grant, and its inactivity limit, as policies.
prefix: The bank sets the full lifetime of a grant, and its inactivity limit, as policies.

text: Now the other side: how a grant ends.
prefix: Now the other side: how a grant ends.

text: Last year Aziz used the mobile bank on a tablet.
prefix: Last year Aziz used the mobile bank on a tablet.

text: This week he cannot find it.
prefix: This week he cannot find it.

text: He calls the bank, and an operator revokes the tablet.
prefix: He calls the bank, and an operator revokes the tablet.

text: The grant of the tablet ends at its next request, not at its next renewal.
prefix: The grant of the tablet ends at its next request, not at its next renewal.

text: If the tablet calls, it is refused.
prefix: If the tablet calls, it is refused.

text: If it tries to renew, the revocation list says no.
prefix: If it tries to renew, the revocation list says no.

text: A grant can end in a few more ways: a block of the customer, a binding mismatch, a replaced phone, a phone number that was removed, a password reset or change on a different device, or simply its lifetime.
prefix: A grant can end in a few more ways: a block of the customer, a binding mismatch, a replaced phone, a phone number that was removed, a password reset or change on a different device, or simply its lifetime.

text: In each case, the app gets the same answer: this grant has ended.
prefix: In each case, the app gets the same answer: this grant has ended.

text: The app tries a renewal.
prefix: The app tries a renewal.

text: When the renewal fails too, Aziz must log in again.
prefix: When the renewal fails too, Aziz must log in again.

text: To recap.
prefix: To recap.

text: The gateway decides, and Keycloak issues.
prefix: The gateway decides, and Keycloak issues.

text: The token names its app and its level.
prefix: The token names its app and its level.

text: A renewal keeps the session alive with no password.
prefix: A renewal keeps the session alive with no password.

text: And one revocation stops a device at its very next request.
prefix: And one revocation stops a device at its very next request.

text: But look at the marketplace.
prefix: But look at the marketplace.

text: Aziz's marketplace token says level one, and the page he wants shows his orders, which needs level two.
prefix: Aziz's marketplace token says level one, and the page he wants shows his orders, which needs level two.

text: Should the marketplace refuse him?
prefix: Should the marketplace refuse him?

text: What does an app do with a level that is too low?
prefix: What does an app do with a level that is too low?
